req.title: Hide environment headers by default
req.statement: The system shall omit environment-controlled internal headers (X-*-Env prefix) from /headers unless show_env=1 is set.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that environment-controlled internal headers (X-*-Env prefix, specifically the ENV_HEADERS tuple in helpers.py) must be omitted from /headers unless show_env=1 is set. The get_headers() function in helpers.py implements this via hide_env=True default and checking 'show_env' in request.args. Tests must cover: (1) positive case - show_env=1 allows env headers through, (2) negative case - without show_env, env headers are stripped, (3) boundary case - show_env=0 still hides headers (only '1' or presence matters per the code: 'show_env' not in request.args). We also test the exact ENV_HEADERS constants to catch constant-mutation operators, and verify the boolean logic of hide_env AND show_env absence.

tests.name: test_headers_default_hides_env_headers
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No show_env query parameter is sent
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core app
Send GET /headers with X-Varnish and X-Request-Start headers injected via WSGI environ
Parse JSON response body
expected: HTTP 200 response
Response JSON contains 'headers' key
X-Varnish header is NOT present in response headers dict
X-Request-Start header is NOT present in response headers dict
X-Forwarded-For header is NOT present in response headers dict
trace: R-HTTPBIN-013: env headers omitted by default
helpers.py get_headers(): hide_env=True and show_env not in request.args -> deletes ENV_HEADERS keys
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_headers_default_hides_env_headers():
    environ_overrides = {
        'HTTP_X_VARNISH': 'abc123',
        'HTTP_X_REQUEST_START': '1234567890',
        'HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR': '1.2.3.4',
    }
    r = client.get('/headers', environ_overrides=environ_overrides)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'headers' in data
    hdrs = data['headers']
    assert 'X-Varnish' not in hdrs
    assert 'X-Request-Start' not in hdrs
    assert 'X-Forwarded-For' not in hdrs

test_headers_default_hides_env_headers()

tests.name: test_headers_all_env_headers_hidden_by_default
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
All ENV_HEADERS are injected into the request
No show_env parameter is sent
actions: Inject all known ENV_HEADERS into the request environ
Send GET /headers without show_env
Assert none of the ENV_HEADERS appear in the response
expected: HTTP 200 response
None of the ENV_HEADERS keys appear in the response headers dict
Non-env headers (e.g. Host) are still present
trace: R-HTTPBIN-013: all env headers must be omitted by default
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
from httpbin.helpers import ENV_HEADERS
client = app.test_client()

def test_headers_all_env_headers_hidden_by_default():
    environ_overrides = {}
    for h in ENV_HEADERS:
        key = 'HTTP_' + h.upper().replace('-', '_')
        environ_overrides[key] = 'testvalue'
    r = client.get('/headers', environ_overrides=environ_overrides)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'headers' in data
    hdrs = data['headers']
    for h in ENV_HEADERS:
        assert h not in hdrs, f'ENV_HEADER {h} should be hidden but was present'
    # Non-env header should still be present
    assert 'Host' in hdrs

test_headers_all_env_headers_hidden_by_default()

tests.name: test_headers_show_env_absent_vs_present_state_transition
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
X-Forwarded-Proto header is injected (an ENV_HEADER)
actions: First request: GET /headers without show_env -> verify X-Forwarded-Proto absent
Second request: GET /headers?show_env=1 -> verify X-Forwarded-Proto present
Third request: GET /headers without show_env again -> verify X-Forwarded-Proto absent again
expected: State 1 (no show_env): X-Forwarded-Proto absent, status 200
State 2 (show_env=1): X-Forwarded-Proto present with value 'https', status 200
State 3 (no show_env): X-Forwarded-Proto absent again, status 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-013: state transition between hide and show modes
Catches mutations that permanently toggle hide_env state
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_headers_show_env_absent_vs_present_state_transition():
    env = {'HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO': 'https'}
    r1 = client.get('/headers', environ_overrides=env)
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    d1 = r1.get_json()
    assert 'X-Forwarded-Proto' not in d1['headers']
    r2 = client.get('/headers?show_env=1', environ_overrides=env)
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    d2 = r2.get_json()
    assert 'X-Forwarded-Proto' in d2['headers']
    assert d2['headers']['X-Forwarded-Proto'] == 'https'
    r3 = client.get('/headers', environ_overrides=env)
    assert r3.status_code == 200
    d3 = r3.get_json()
    assert 'X-Forwarded-Proto' not in d3['headers']

test_headers_show_env_absent_vs_present_state_transition()
